title: One NFIP Building Policy per Building — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) Underwriting Rule
content:
## Underwriting rule: one NFIP building policy per building

**The rule.** The National Flood Insurance Program allows only one NFIP policy with building coverage on a building, and only one NFIP contents policy per insured occupant of the same premises. A new NFIP Dwelling Form building policy is issued only when no other Dwelling Form policy with building coverage at the same property address is in status pending effective, in force or renewal grace.

**Coexisting policies.** A tenant contents policy at a property address can coexist with the owner's building policy at that address because the insureds differ, and a condominium unit policy can coexist with the association's Residential Condominium Building Association Policy on the building, because the unit policy responds only to the unit owner's own interest.

**Duplicates.** When two building policies on the same building are found in force, the one with the later original effective date is the duplicate and is cancelled under the reason Duplicate NFIP Policy; the earlier policy is never the one cancelled. Limits are never added across duplicate policies: a loss is adjusted only under the policy that remains.

### Basis of the issuance check

- The check is made on Tidemark's own policy records before a new building policy is issued, not on the customer's statement.
- The records compared are the property address, the status and the building coverage of every Dwelling Form policy at that address; the policy to be issued is matched to them by its property address.
- A policy at the same address blocks issuance only when it carries building coverage and its status is pending effective, in force or renewal grace.

| Other Dwelling Form policy found at the same property address | Effect on a new building policy |
|---|---|
| Building coverage, status pending effective | Not issued |
| Building coverage, status in force | Not issued |
| Building coverage, status renewal grace | Not issued |
| Building coverage, status lapsed, cancelled or nullified | Does not block issuance |
| A tenant's contents-only policy | Does not block issuance (the insureds differ) |

*Hypothetical case.* Two building policies on one building are found in force, one first effective on an earlier date and the other on a later date. The later-dated policy is the duplicate and is the one cancelled under Duplicate NFIP Policy; a loss is adjusted only under the earlier policy, and the two building limits are never added together.
